milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dark oak door is at spawn-relative (6, 1, 4) on the cabin's front wall. The player must navigate close enough to see it and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from the spawn area since the door is only ~7 blocks away and clearly visible from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the door, not just passing by.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The campfire is at spawn-relative (6, 1, 8) inside the enclosed cabin. max_distance=8 is used (tighter than default 16) because the campfire is enclosed by spruce plank walls on all sides — the player must actually approach or enter the cabin through the dark oak door to observe it. A larger distance would allow false positives from outside the walls. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the campfire.
